issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies Farm.addAnimal(animal: Animal):boolean (returns boolean), but the provided solution implements addAnimal as void and the template's Main calls farm.addAnimal(...) assuming no return value. This mismatch between the UML/description and the implementation can confuse students about the expected return type and behavior of addAnimal.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type of addAnimal consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the UML/problem statement to declare addAnimal(animal: Animal):void to match the template and solution, or (B) change the template and solution to implement addAnimal to return boolean (e.g., return true if added) and update any call sites (Main and tests) accordingly.
